parameters.name: wid
parameters.description: Not needed: the workspace comes from your token. If you send it, it must be your `workspace_id`.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Ecosystem filter. `all` (or omitted) = no filter. `xstocks` = only xStock (Backed Finance tokenized equity) holdings.

parameters.name: minValue
parameters.description: Hide holdings with market value below this USD threshold

parameters.name: calculatedBalances
parameters.description: Show Calculated Balance — swaps the data source to `calculated_balances`, returning every wallet's ledger-derived balances (API wallets included) instead of provider-reported holdings.

parameters.name: excludeCalculatedBalances
parameters.description: Drop ledger-derived rows from the holdings list, returning only provider-reported balances. Derived rows are the ones projected for CSV-fed and custom wallets, which have no provider to report a balance. Default false = both are returned.
